scope: Compatibility audit; diagnostic scripts only; production binary, accounts and selected node unchanged

verified_matches.native_2_0_29_and_2_0_32_application_hea: same in explicit Chat runtime fixture

findings.finding: Baseline and final profile accept HTTP 200 even if the body contains only an SSE error
findings.impact: The adaptation indicator may be green without successful inference

findings.finding: An HTTP 200 SSE error becomes an interrupted response.completed and then an empty successful Chat completion
findings.impact: Upstream error details disappear; response and request-log status can be misleading

findings.finding: Router reference is pinned to 2.0.29 while latest official CLI is 2.0.32
findings.impact: The adaptation workflow does not automatically adopt an unverified newer release; matching an older reference does not prove current release compatibility

findings.finding: Router still uses one legacy shared inference root and a model-name heuristic, while official release sources use protocol-specific endpoints
findings.impact: Endpoint compatibility needs independent verification; no proof that migrating the path resolves an access denial

findings.finding: Chat translation drops generation parameters and reasoning_effort; requested tool_choice none becomes auto
Image content is lost when Responses-style items are flattened back into Chat messages
findings.impact: Multimodal input is not preserved on this route; model support must still be checked separately

findings.finding: Router proxy path uses 20-second response-header timeout, 12-second first-event timeout and up to 8 attempts; official provider docs describe 5-minute header/chunk waits and up to 3 timeout retries
findings.impact: Slow but valid generations can have different behavior; no equivalent default inter-chunk guard was established in the router

findings.finding: Fresh fallback configuration still carries V1 defaults and the main fallback model is deprecated Muse
findings.impact: Applies when a verified profile or explicit model setting is unavailable, not proof that the current saved VPS profile reverted

findings.finding: Native client owns and executes its tool registry; router adds aliases or tools and drops calls without a caller equivalent
findings.impact: The same tool names do not establish equivalent agent behavior

findings.finding: Transport implementation differs: native client transport and keep-alive versus Go proxy transport with keep-alive disabled
findings.impact: Connection reuse and compression behavior differ; TLS/network fingerprints were not captured and no 403 cause is established

limitations: Successful current-version captures explicitly select the per-model localhost endpoint and OpenAI Chat runtime; they do not verify live built-in catalog routing or upstream authorization
The first provider-only baseURL fixture failed before recording a request for 2.0.32 with an invalid-credential response; retained separately and excluded from successful comparisons
Native 2.0.32 did not finish the synthetic unknown SSE error case within 40 seconds; native error handling is inconclusive in that case
Prompt-cache-key presence changed when the runtime was explicitly selected in both versions; this is configuration-dependent and not a proven 2.0.32-only change
No new real provider inference or IP rotation was requested by this audit; older official-client VPS/laptop comparison is separately dated evidence
The precise cause of recurring FreeTierError remains unverified; neither changing a User-Agent nor matching tools establishes permission to use a restricted endpoint
